name: ai-dev-kit-mods
description: Optional Claude Code mods for the ai-dev-kit: token ledger, commit and edit guards, standards checks, a debugging reminder, output compaction. Mods that need more than a few rules run a tool-agnostic script from a skill.

plugins.name: budget-ledger
plugins.description: Logs real token usage, cost, cache and tool-result sizes per turn, one file per session; adds /budget. Observes only.

plugins.name: precommit-gate
plugins.description: Gates git commit and push (Bash and PowerShell): blocks leaked secrets, secret files, bad messages and --no-verify; needs the pre-commit skill's check.js.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Denies edits to secret files, lockfiles and .git, and destructive Bash or PowerShell commands (root-like recursive deletes, force push, deleting remote main, reset --hard, clean -f, publish, download piped into a shell). Config in .claude/guard.json.

plugins.name: edit-check
plugins.description: After each Edit or Write, runs the pre-merge-gate skill's edit-check.js and shows the model only the problems (syntax, ESLint, Stylelint, coding-standards rules).

plugins.name: debug-nudge
plugins.description: Reminds the model once, at the second failed fix of a test/build command (Bash or PowerShell), to stop editing and apply the debug-protocol skill. Reminder only.

plugins.name: standards-chain
plugins.description: Denies the first Edit or Write of a file until its coding-standards chain (index, discipline file, role partial, framework file) has been read, and again after a compaction. Does nothing without a coding-standards/ folder.

plugins.name: output-compact
plugins.description: Runs the session-budget skill's compact.js on every Bash/PowerShell result before the model reads it: drops noise, keeps every failure line, no-ops below its own savings floor or when the engine is missing.

plugins.name: prefilter-rank
plugins.description: Ranks Grep/Glob results (5-40 files) by relevance to the task using the local Laya prefilter (system1-prefilter addon); calls 127.0.0.1 only, checked in code. No-ops if the addon isn't configured for local Laya, if a hosted provider's key is set instead, or if Laya isn't reachable within a short timeout.

plugins.name: learnings-inject
plugins.description: Adds a skill's learnings.md to the Skill call result once per session, so the skill's start-of-skill read needs no tool call. Context only; never blocks.

plugins.name: eta-nudge
plugins.description: Reminder only: nudges once when a Bash/PowerShell call is backgrounded, and every 10 minutes of wall-clock task time after the first 5, to restate or give a time estimate and checkpoint (plan-first's rule). Never computes the estimate itself, never blocks.

plugins.name: aiignore-guard
plugins.description: Keeps the AI out of files it should not read: the project's .aiignore, paths that belong to another role (conflict-roles.json: the active role's out list, or anything another role lists under in), the current task's scope (/focus, else the role's board row) and folders local Laya judges unrelated to the prompt. The first touch of such a path is denied with the snag protocol (rank names with prefilter, retry once); unscoped Grep and Glob results come back without ignored and out-of-role files. Does nothing without these files.
